colorTokenFiles.description: Repo-relative paths of files that define color tokens (e.g. src/styles.css). Raw color values are allowed here — they're the source of truth.

rules.description: Per-rule configuration keyed by rule name (matches the file in scripts/lint-color/rules/). Set "enabled" to false to turn a rule off.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable this rule entirely.

description.description: What this rule enforces — shown in the console when a violation is found.

allowed.description: Per-prefix allow lists (token-constraints rule). Key is a color prefix (text, border, …) or "hover:" for the hover variant. Token must match at least one pattern in the list.

denied.description: Per-prefix deny lists (token-constraints rule). Key is a color prefix or "*" as fallback. Token must not match any pattern.

interactiveElements.description: Additional HTML tags treated as interactive by the no-useless-hover rule (hover: is allowed on these).

componentsDirectory.description: Repo-relative path to scan for UI components (no-component-color-override rule). Each .tsx file becomes a component name; passing color classes to these via className is disallowed.

replacement.description: Per-prefix replacement hints (no-spectral-color rule). Each entry maps a spectral color + shade range to a semantic token name, e.g. { "green-400...600": "success-content" }. Shown in the violation message.
